newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL BNDESPAR SELLS PETROBRAS PREFERENCE SHARES.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL BNDESPAR SELLS PETROBRAS PREFERENCE SHARES.

text.p: BNDESpar, the investment arm of Brazil's National Development Bank, has launched a global offer of preference shares in state oil and gas giant Petrobras held in its portfolio, worth 522 million reais.
BNDESpar is offering 1.8 billion shares, the equivalent of 3.98 percent of Petrobras preference share capital or 1.66 percent of total capital.
A base price of 290 reais per lot of 1,000 shares has been set.

Under the global offer, 350 million shares are on offer in Brazil, and 1.45 billion shares are on offer abroad in the form of American Depository Shares (ADS). Every ADS represents 100 Petrobras preference shares.
Credit Suisse First Boston is coordinating the global offer, with Brazil's Banco Bozano, Simonsen and Itau Bankers Trust overseeing the share offer in Brazil.
The global offer can be increased by up to 200 million preference shares should there be an excess in demand.

In May, BNDESpar carried out a similar offer with the sale of one billion Petrobras preference shares for 240.99 million reais, up 0.26 percent above the base price of 240.37 million reais. ($o1.08 reais)
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
